Test_Description: Verify MIPI CSI-2 D-PHY lane configuration and data transfer across all lane configurations (4-lane down to 1-lane). The test iterates from 4 lanes to 1 lane, configuring the CSI-2 controller, performing DMA-based control and data packet transfers, and verifying interrupt-driven completion for each lane configuration.
Pre_Conditions: System powered on; CSI-2 subsystem clocked; D-PHY in reset state; GDMA0 path selected (default); VC_ID=3; VRES=3; HRES=64; DATA_TYPE=CSI2_RGB888; LS_LE_EN=1; TOTAL_FRAME=1
Test_Steps:
Step 1: Enable CSI-2 interrupts via csi2_enable_interrupt()
Step 2: Configure virtual channel register for GDMA0 path (VC_ID=3 shifted to bits[15:12])
Step 3: Enable control data transfer
Step 4: Execute D-PHY initialization sequence via snps_phy_init()
Step 5: Poll PHY_STOPSTATE register until all lanes and clock in stop state (0x1000F)
Step 6: Loop lane_num from 3 down to 0:
  Step 6a: Write N_LANES register with lane_num
  Step 6b: Trigger CSI-2 sequence via write to 0xA0243FFC
  Step 6c: For each control packet: enable DMA IRQ, preload DMA ch0 instructions, execute DMAGO for ch0, poll INTMIS for ch0 completion, clear IRQ
  Step 6d: Read control data from 0xE6001000, extract data_type and word_count
  Step 6e: If long packet (data_type > 0xF): preload DMA ch1 instructions for CSI data, execute DMAGO for ch1, poll INTMIS for ch1 completion, clear IRQ
Step 7: Call finish(0)

Test_Description: Verify MIPI CSI-2 internal test pattern generator (PG) functionality. The test configures the PG with RGB888 data type (0x24), VC=3, HRES=320, VRES=16, enables PG to generate internal test patterns, and verifies DMA-based data reception and interrupt-driven completion without external D-PHY input.
Pre_Conditions: System powered on; CSI-2 subsystem clocked; D-PHY in reset state; GDMA0 path selected (default); vcid=3; hres=320; vres=16; valid_bits_per_pixel=24 (RGB888)
Test_Steps:
Step 1: Configure virtual channel register for selected GDMA path
Step 2: Disable control data transfer (PG mode uses data path only)
Step 3: Enable CSI-2 and DMA subsystem interrupts
Step 4: Execute D-PHY initialization sequence
Step 5: Poll PHY_STOPSTATE until all lanes and clock in stop state (0x1000F)
Step 6: Configure higher-order DMA address bits for AXI addressing
Step 7: Enable fracdiv output to CSI2 subsystem (write 0x1 to RB_BASE+0xF4)
Step 8: Preload DMA ch0 instructions for data transfer (src=0x00, dest=0xE6001000, size=calculated)
Step 9: Execute DMAGO for DMA ch0
Step 10: Configure and enable Pattern Generator:
  - PPI_PG_PATTERN_VRES = 0x10 (16 lines)
  - PPI_PG_PATTERN_HRES = 0x70140 (pkt2pkt_time=7, hres=320)
  - PPI_PG_CONFIG = 0xE401 (vc=3, datatype=0x24/RGB888, pattern=vertical)
  - PPI_PG_ENABLE = 1
Step 11: Wait 100 cycles
Step 12: Disable Pattern Generator (PPI_PG_ENABLE = 0)
Step 13: Poll DMA INTMIS for ch0 completion
Step 14: Wait 10000 cycles
Step 15: Call finish(0)
